what: Article 11 rewrites parts of the zoning bylaw to match recent changes to the state Zoning Act: variances would turn on "practical difficulty" instead of "substantial hardship", some additions to older nonconforming homes would be allowed without a special permit, a nonconforming use would be lost after four years of abandonment instead of two, and a permit's protection would run twenty-four months instead of six.
